provenance.note: Tiruchirappalli district's rivers, groundwater and industry (scope tiruchirappalli-rivers; the district's own scope id is tn-tiruchirappalli). The district boundary is the frame and TN WRD's sub-basins, clipped to it, are the catchments (shedId). The industry register holds only units TNGIS matched to a land parcel, so every count is a lower bound; sector comes from the reviewed TNPCB type-code lookup pipeline-inputs/basins/tn-tnpcb-type-sectors.json.
